text: How does NavisAI actually work? Here's the whole system, top to bottom. It takes a folder of shipping PDFs, and turns them into a bank ready decision, in four stages.

Stage One: Ingestion and Adaptive Audit. NavisAI reads four documents: the Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, and Letter of Credit. Simple paperwork goes to a fast extraction pass; dense legal clauses go to an extended reasoning pass. Then every shared field, container I Ds, weights, H S codes, ports, gets compared across all four documents at once.

Stage Two: Visual Redline Diff. For every mismatch, NavisAI lines up the wrong value, struck through in red, next to the verified fix, highlighted in green, just like a lawyer redlining a contract. One toggle applies the fix immediately.

Stage Three: the Cross Border Statutory Gate. Independent of whether the numbers match, NavisAI checks the shipment against the actual laws a bank or customs officer would cite: U C P six hundred Articles fourteen and eighteen, MITI ATIGA Form D rules of origin, and destination customs standards like Port of Rotterdam clearance.

Stage Four: the Navis Dispatch Engine. Every remaining issue is routed to whoever can actually fix it: a carrier amendment to the shipping line, a trade finance alert to the bank desk, or a customs broker inquiry, each pre-drafted and queued, ready for one click.

And here's the payoff: applying a fix doesn't just update one screen. Before the fix: at risk, a risk score of sixty four, three discrepancies, seven hundred fifty dollars of exposure. After: ready, zero risk, zero discrepancies, zero dollars. Every downstream stage re-checks itself automatically.

The business case is simple: a forty five minute manual audit becomes four seconds. Each shipment avoids one hundred fifty to four hundred fifty dollars in bank fees and demurrage. The adaptive router saves about sixty percent in compute, at just point zero zero one six dollars per audit.

This is built for a trade operations auditor working through a queue of shipments before bank presentation: someone who needs to know exactly which law a mismatch breaks, and needs something they can send, not just a red flag.
That's NavisAI: four stages, one continuous run, turning hours of manual document chasing into seconds, before a discrepancy ever becomes a penalty.
